summary: Validated live Expo mobile preview and core backend flows. Admin and collaborator login, dashboard projections, campaign persistence/restore, collaborator permissions, tab navigation, and client validation passed.

integration_issues.issue: src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/extra.backendUrl instead of the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is also present.

action_items: Update frontend API base URL resolution to use EXPO_BACKEND_URL as the canonical environment key while preserving current preview behavior.
Add testID attributes to all interactive and critical informational controls (login fields/button, tabs, scenario selectors, data fields/save, team invite/modal fields).
critical_code_review_comments: All referenced source files are within manageable size and use React Native primitives/StyleSheet. Auth token validation and server-side admin authorization are present.
JWT fallback secret is weak and produces an InsecureKeyLengthWarning; production should require a sufficiently long JWT_SECRET rather than defaulting.
seed_data_creation: None; campaign was restored to its original values after persistence testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview tested at mobile viewport 375x667. Admin dashboard showed 10,480 real projection; collaborator could view/update screens but invite was hidden and API returned 403. Invalid empty target displayed the expected Portuguese validation message.
rca_of_issue: Configuration compliance issue: frontend/src/api.ts constructs API_URL from Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the deployment contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL. No failure occurred in this preview because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is currently defined.
